stageReason: The key move is quiet (c6); the win itself is a simple fork.

idea.ru: Белые взяли пешку e5; пешка c6 гонит слона, а шах ферзём с a5 забирает коня.
idea.en: White took the e5-pawn; the c6-pawn hits the bishop, and a queen check from a5 picks up the knight.
